name: today
title: The sales floor today
subtitle: Who is waiting, who is booked in, and what has gone quiet. Rendered by npm run view

sections.title: Waiting for a first answer
sections.note: Every open lead nobody has called, texted or emailed back yet, oldest first.
sections.sql: select code as lead, contact as customer, source, site as yard, coalesce(salesperson, 'NOBODY') as with_salesperson, response_minutes as minutes_waiting from v_open_leads where first_response_at is null order by received_at

sections.title: Booked in, next seven days
sections.sql: select to_char(ap.starts_at at time zone coalesce((select value from settings where key = 'timezone'), 'Pacific/Auckland'), 'Dy DD Mon HH24:MI') as booked, replace(ap.kind, '_', ' ') as kind, l.code as lead, c.full_name as customer, c.mobile, s.full_name as with_salesperson from appointments ap join leads l on l.id = ap.lead_id join contacts c on c.id = l.contact_id left join staff s on s.id = ap.staff_id where ap.outcome is null and ap.starts_at >= now() - interval '2 hours' and ap.starts_at < now() + interval '7 days' order by ap.starts_at

sections.title: Follow-ups overdue
sections.sql: select code as lead, contact as customer, salesperson, next_action as promised, next_action_on as was_due from v_open_leads where next_action_on < biz_today() order by next_action_on

sections.title: Gone quiet
sections.note: Answered once, then no call, text, email or visit for a week or more.
sections.sql: select code as lead, contact as customer, salesperson, stage, days_quiet from v_open_leads where first_response_at is not null and days_quiet >= coalesce((select value::int from settings where key = 'quiet_days'), 7) order by days_quiet desc

name: sources
title: Lead sources
subtitle: What each source sent and what it turned into

sections.title: Every lead each source has sent
sections.note: Repeat enquiries from someone already being looked after are not counted twice.
sections.sql: select name as source, leads, responded, appointments, test_drives, sold, lost, monthly_spend_cents from v_source_funnel order by sold desc, leads desc

name: team
title: The team
subtitle: Load, speed to answer and results per person

sections.title: Each person on the floor
sections.sql: select full_name as name, replace(role, '_', ' ') as role, site as yard, open_leads, overdue, avg_response_minutes, sold, closed, case when away_until >= biz_today() then 'away until ' || away_until else '' end as away from v_team order by site, full_name
